Title: The Last of the Mohicans
Plot: In war-torn colonial America, in the midst of a bloody battle between British, the French and Native American allies, the aristocratic daughter of a British Colonel and her party are captured by a group of Huron warriors. Fortunately, a group of three Mohican trappers comes to their rescue.
Tagline: An epic adventure and passionate romance unfold against the panorama of a frontier wilderness ravaged by war.
